As someone who played this game for +400 hrs since release. I absolutely do not recommend.
-This game is just a grind game with no purpose. The content is basically waste days of your life grinding for a character then move on to the next. 
-The gameplay is fun but repetitive and gets boring very fast. Once you grind for all characters and try them, there is absolutely nothing beyond that. 
-Every now and then they will release an upgraded character for the ones you have as a way to waste your resources and make you grind for the better one that literally plays the same but has access to more damage and stats. 
-It locks life quality features behind paywalls. The game is designed to make u spend money to have a comfortable gameplay. Classic create issues sell solutions schemes. 
-U can grind for weeks for a character or just pay and get them at the spot. 
-There are timers everywhere that take days and can be negated if u pay. 
-This game basically has no content other than grind for new character and wait for the next one. 
-Every now and then they release some content including few modes that are just grind events again, but they release and tons of gooner skins which tells u where the devs focus is. 
-There are also pets among many thing that exist only to make you spend money in this game. 
-You literally can not have a number of characters without paying money, forcing u into paying or just deleting characters and replacing them with others which basically deletes everything u every grinded for that character. 
-They also lock mechanisms behind new characters making new characters  solve these mechanisms much easier compared to the older characters.
-Their monetization is heavily dependent on almost-nude gooner skins. The lobby is literally filled with such skins which just ruins the experience. 
-The game overall does not have a good reputation. 
-This game is just junk that is charged with horrendous monetization schemes. I used to think that a game has to be P2W is the worst kind of monetization, then I played this game. A game that is literally Pay-to-Play, locking content behind insanely time consuming grind or just straight paywalls.
 There are better games out there and u don't have to chain yourself to this one cause it literally has no future just never ending grind for nothing.
